value.message: Town of Oakville's Learn to Swim Preschool A runs Saturdays 9:00-9:30 a.m. and Preschool B 9:40-10:10, Sept 12 to Nov 28, ages 3-5 - their site says; registration opens Tue, Aug 11 at 7 a.m. for residents.
